title: A row label's width number sits under the label, not above it with a leader
goal: When Size mode measures a text label inside a settings row, the width number currently jumps above the label's right end with a leader line, because the next row is close beneath. Redliners expect the number under the caliper, where a heading's number already lands. The number should sit in the band between the label and the divider when it fits, and only then move away.
notes: See queue/audits/2026-09-02-text-line-3-label-hover-zoom.png. The planner (MeasureLabelPlanner.plan describing:/avoiding:) is handed the label as subject and the neighbours from ElementBounds.neighbors(of:) at two reaches; the far probe lands on the next row (or its label), so the space under the caliper counts as on a neighbour and the above-right slot with a leader wins. Options: let the strip between the subject and the next neighbour count as clear when the chip fits in it, or weigh a neighbour that is a row less than one that is a control.
acceptance: On the settings-pane fixture, Size-click the Launch at login label: the width number sits below the label and above the row divider, with no leader line.
The heading and button readouts on the same fixture land where they land today.
